description: Loads products, customers, delivery addresses and the customer catalogue from four spreadsheets saved as CSV files in the Knowledge folder Order Desk/Import (products.csv, customers.csv, delivery_addresses.csv, customer_catalogue.csv). Existing rows are updated, new ones are added, nothing is deleted. Run it again whenever the files change. A missing file is skipped.
